def.brief: Documentation only (owner direction: document the exact cross-batch limit). README's Limits bullet on the late eyes' diff says: the diff is cut at 80000 characters and says so (diff_truncated), and git is asked for no more once that is passed; without a base, an unresolved merge conflict appears as git prints it (a combined diff --cc section, or the line '* Unmerged path PATH' for a modify/delete conflict); and across pathspec batches a combined section can come after other paths' sections, where one git call would put it first — nothing is lost or repeated. Checked by its diff and git diff --check, not by the suite.
